method.canonical: all feature/example/sample/showcase manifests; each supplied scenario runs under T00 and the T11-generated program
method.probes: additional existing T00 contracts drawn from interpreter tests; exact source is included for reproduction

method.limits: Finite corpus and explicit probes, not proof for every program. Compile-only acceptance does not imply runtime parity. T11 remains a restricted compiler.
